experiment_data.hypothesis: Same-seed (seed=42) 4-condition gradient analysis eliminates cross-seed confound. Compares Vanilla vs Full OCC vs Detach+BN vs Full OCC+LN gradient properties at 50K checkpoint. Tests whether gradient flow patterns (norm, cosine, conflict rate) are consistent with mixed-seed results.

spec.command: python gradient_analysis_same_seed.py (4 conditions: Vanilla/Full OCC BN/Detach BN/Full OCC LN, all seed=42, 200 batches)
